text: Healthy living means taking care of your body and mind. First, eat a balanced diet with plenty of fruit, vegetables, and whole grains, and try to avoid too much sugar and fast food. Regular exercise is also important; even a short walk every day can make a big difference. Don't forget to get enough sleep, because it helps you feel fresh and focused. Mental health matters too, so take time to relax and talk to friends when you feel stressed. Finally, try to keep a good work-life balance by setting clear limits between your job and your free time. Small daily habits can lead to a healthier, happier life.
